name: The 45° Bastion & Relic Cairn
act: Act II: The Watch on the Overhang & The Grey Wind's Bargain
description: A monolithic stone bastion leaning at an impossible 45-degree overhang, defying gravity because the world's ancient overhang rule permits exactly 45 degrees. Climbing to z=24m uncovers Surveyor Vellum's calibrated theodolite and the True Name of the Seventh Ruin.

cast.name: Surveyor-Senior Vellum
cast.description: Seeking to reclaim his stolen theodolite from the summit cairn to certify the road north in Act III.

cast.name: Pell the Underwritten
cast.description: Scrambling across the 45-degree stone overhang using structural handholds to avoid ground-level crossfire.

primitives.name: North 45° Overhang Ancient Bastion
primitives.description: Cyclopean masonry fortress projecting outward at 45 degrees over the northwest abyss. Survives unpatched from the First Epoch.

primitives.name: Theodolite Station & Relic Cairn
primitives.stage_role: High Geodetic Marker & Ruin Name Cache
primitives.description: Summit monument housing Vellum's calibrated theodolite and the weathered slate tally of Aethel-Vorn (the city that wished for no winters).
